intro: A mechanical engineer resume that shows products designed and improved, with the cost, weight or reliability gains they brought.
tips: Show products and parts you designed, start to finish.
Give results: cost, weight, reliability, time to market.
List CAD and analysis tools and any certifications.

basics.name: Erik Johansson
basics.label: Mechanical Engineer
basics.summary: Mechanical engineer with six years designing components for vehicles and industrial machines. I like the whole journey, from a sketch to a part that is easy to make.

work.name: Volvo Group
highlights: Design cab components for heavy trucks, from concept to production.
Redesigned a bracket family; 22% lighter and SEK 3m a year cheaper to make.
Lead design reviews with suppliers and the production plant.

work.name: Nordic Machines
highlights: Designed parts for a new packaging line; first machine delivered in 11 months.
Used FEA to fix a fatigue failure that had caused 40 field returns.
